reason: Neither conversation correctly identified E011 as 'key pressed too long' and both wrongly floated a temperature sensor fault, but both landed on drying the panel and power-cycling and both reached the correct no-part outcome. Conversation 1 gave a proportionate reset (10-15 minutes at the cooker switch, which the homeowner sensibly followed) and confirmed resolution without inventing further work. Conversation 2 told the owner to unplug a built-in oven for 24 hours and pre-emptively raised 'permanent damage' and component replacement, which was alarmist and impractical for this situation, though it did add a useful prevention tip about spraying onto a cloth rather than the panel.
